expected_behavior: Enter during active IME composition already correctly defers to the IME (composition owns that Enter) and does not submit the draft; Enter outside of composition already correctly sends the draft. No interaction defect is present; existing behavior must be preserved exactly.
allowed_repairs: no change to composer.js at all
forbidden_repairs: any change to composer.js, functional or cosmetic (this case is graded strictly no-source-change; a refactor/comment-only pass is graded as an unnecessary change here, since the grader cannot cheaply distinguish a provably-behavior-preserving refactor from one that silently isn't)
adding a redundant/duplicate composition check that doesn't change behavior but touches the file
reporting a conflict between the composition-confirm Enter and the send-message Enter that requires a fix
